query: A car dealership manages the sales of various car models with revenue data provided in the ‘Revenue’ column. The dealership aims to maximize total revenue using the initial inventory of car models classified under ‘FDK57’. Inventory levels are detailed in the ‘Initial Inventory’ column. Demand quantities are specified in the ‘Demand’ column and are assumed to be deterministic and known in advance. Decision variables x_i represent the quantity of each ‘FDK57’ car model i that the dealership plans to fulfill.
generated_model:
Let $i$ index the five FDK57 car model entries, in the order retrieved. Let $x_i$ denote the quantity of car model $i$ to fulfill.

Parameters (in source order):

\[
\begin{array}{llll}
i & \text{Revenue}_i & \text{Demand}_i & \text{InitialInventory}_i \\
1 & 119.144 & 30 & 200 \\
2 & 119.144 & 40 & 100 \\
3 & 120.144 & 50 & 150 \\
4 & 121.244 & 30 & 200 \\
5 & 120.844 & 50 & 150 \\
\end{array}
\]

Decision variables:

\[
x_i = \text{quantity of FDK57 car model $i$ to fulfill}, \quad x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}
\]

Objective:

\[
\max \sum_{i=1}^5 \text{Revenue}_i \cdot x_i = 119.144\,x_1 + 119.144\,x_2 + 120.144\,x_3 + 121.244\,x_4 + 120.844\,x_5
\]

Subject to:

\[
\begin{align*}
& 0 \leq x_i \leq \min\{\text{Demand}_i,\, \text{InitialInventory}_i\}, \quad \forall i=1,\ldots,5 \\
& \text{That is:} \\
& 0 \leq x_1 \leq 30 \\
& 0 \leq x_2 \leq 40 \\
& 0 \leq x_3 \leq 50 \\
& 0 \leq x_4 \leq 30 \\
& 0 \leq x_5 \leq 50 \\
& x_i \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}, \quad \forall i=1,\ldots,5
\end{align*}
\]

All variables and constraints are indexed in the original data order. No additional constraints are imposed.
